brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Half-north bases stacked at levels 0, 1, 2 in cell 0,0.
bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-half-n-full is open at the top of level 2.

finish.summary: A three-storey tower of half bases. It has a drawer on the bottom storey and an open full-depth bin on the top storey. The middle storey is plain. I added end caps and locked the joints. check_build reports no issues and the mesh check is clear. I added no props, since the brief doesn't ask for any. The look call returned no view, so I haven't seen the tower.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
